tagline.en_US: Track devices and vehicles, manage geofences and view reports from a browser-based dashboard.

description.en_US: Traccar is an open source GPS tracking platform. It supports more than 200 GPS protocols and thousands of tracking device models, connecting with major SQL databases and providing a REST API. The platform enables users to track vehicles, assets, or people in real time, monitor driver behavior, configure geofences, and review detailed reports and notifications.
